column4: ["The MedUnity clinic is proud to announce the arrival of the latest generation echocardiography equipment.","This cutting-edge technology allows for more precise and faster cardiac diagnoses, improving patient care and reducing waiting times.","Our cardiology team has already been trained on this new system and is ready to put it to use for your health."]

["Great news for our patients: the MedUnity patient portal has been improved!","You can now download your exam results (blood tests, X-rays, scans) directly in PDF format with just one click.","Access to your medical history is faster and more secure than ever.","Log in today and discover the new features designed for your comfort."]

["Save the date: Free community seminar on diabetes prevention!","Join us on Saturday, January 18, 2026, from 10 AM to 12 PM at the MedUnity clinic.","Our specialists will cover risk factors, warning signs, healthy lifestyle tips, and the latest screening methods.","Open to all — registration recommended via our website or by phone."]
